installation: Fresh candidate copy and venv with --system-site-packages; the candidate setup.sh runs with PIP_NO_INDEX=1 (without one, the documented pip install -e . --no-build-isolation runs and the receipt records it).
dependency_basis: Distribution names and versions observed with importlib.metadata in the pinned image (network none) on 2026-10-18; the image holds no task package.
sandbox_provided_by: Docker controller; the Python harness alone is not a sandbox.
candidate_readiness: Per-run binding and actual candidate execution are required; authored controls never certify a candidate.
